description: This file defines game logic functions for a Tic Tac Toe game, including determining a winner, checking for a draw, getting the next player, and applying a move to the game board.

methods.name: calculateWinner(board)
methods.description: Computes the winner of the current Tic Tac Toe board by checking all possible winning lines. Returns an object with the winner ('X' or 'O') or null, and the line of the winning positions.

methods.name: isDraw(board)
methods.description: Checks if the game is a draw — no winner and all cells are filled.

methods.name: getNextPlayer(board)
methods.description: Determines which player's turn is next based on the current state of the board.

methods.name: applyMove(board, index, player)
methods.description: Returns a new board after applying a move at a specified position for the given player, or returns the original board if the move is invalid or the game is already won.
